description: This is a wooden dressing table featuring a detachable mirror with a decorative, arched frame. The table has three drawers, with the bottom one partially open, revealing a dark, textured interior. A patterned rug or cloth, predominantly in shades of blue and beige, is casually draped over the tabletop, partially covering a lighter, possibly marble or painted, surface. The mirror's surface shows a distressed or cracked pattern, adding to an aged aesthetic. The drawer pulls are diamond-shaped, complementing the overall classic design of the piece.
